requirement: The smart-home controller shall offer installed device integrations a service that converts arbitrary sensor and camera payloads into ciphertext before they leave the hub, so that only the paired mobile app can read them.
The database server must provide column-level cryptographic transformation of stored values so that a person with raw access to the data files cannot read the contents of designated fields.
The compiler shall let build scripts obfuscate embedded string literals and licence keys within the output binary so that they cannot be read by inspecting the executable.
The web browser shall compare a cryptographic digest of every downloaded extension package against the digest published by its store and shall refuse to install the package when the two differ.
The screen capture tool must attach a keyed hash to each saved recording and shall verify that hash on playback so that any edit made to the file after capture is detected.
The air traffic control software shall encrypt flight-plan updates exchanged between control centres so that an eavesdropper on the network link cannot interpret their contents.
The web browser must transmit form submissions only over encrypted connections so that intermediaries on the network path are unable to read the submitted values.
The electronic purse shall encrypt balance and transaction data exchanged with a merchant terminal so that a device that has not proven its identity cannot read that data.
The data warehousing system shall encrypt customer records moving from the extraction service to the load service so that no unauthorised party can read them while in transit.
The hospital patient-record system must keep diagnosis details hidden from unauthorised staff and external systems whenever it sends them to the pharmacy module.
The sales forecasting system shall prevent unauthorised readers from viewing confidential revenue figures that it passes from the data collector to the model engine.
The simulation software shall check, upon receiving proprietary model parameters from a remote solver node, that the parameters arrived under encryption and shall reject them if they did not.
The online banking application must confirm that account statements received from the core ledger service were delivered through an encrypted channel before it displays them to the customer.
The online booking system shall validate that guest passport and payment details received from a partner agency were shielded against disclosure in transit, and shall discard any that were not.
The hospital patient-record system shall block further sign-in attempts from an account for a defined period after a configured number of consecutive failed attempts.
The online booking system must slow down and eventually refuse repeated failed login requests originating from the same network address in order to hinder automated guessing.
The screen capture tool shall suspend unlocking of its protected recording library after several unsuccessful unlock attempts and shall require a waiting period before accepting another try.

When a clinician's credential check fails, the hospital patient-record system shall deny access, apply the configured response such as a temporary lockout, and notify the genuine account holder if the credentials were presented again after having been captured.

The simulation software must reject a compute node whose certificate fails verification and shall react according to the configured policy, including isolating that node from the cluster when repeated forged identities are detected.

If a controller's identity check or privilege check fails, the air traffic control software shall refuse the session and shall execute the response defined by the operating authority, which may include alerting the legitimate controller about reused login tokens.
The smart-home controller shall recognise when a previously captured pairing message from a door lock or sensor is sent again and shall flag it as an attack.
The online booking system must detect when a session token that was already used and retired is presented again by a client.
The online banking application shall identify one-time authorisation codes that have been submitted more than once and shall treat the repeat as a replay attempt.
When the web browser finds that an authentication assertion from a site has been resubmitted by an attacker, it shall terminate the affected browsing session and clear its authenticated state.
Upon identifying a replayed transfer authorisation, the online banking application must halt the pending payment and end the customer session involved.
If the compiler's licence server connection receives a re-sent licence grant that it has already honoured, the compiler shall abort the running build job and release its licence checkout.

The database server shall enforce a documented data-protection rule that lists which tables and fields hold personal or business-critical content and limits their viewing to explicitly permitted roles.
The electronic purse must apply a written rule that identifies cardholder identity data and spending history as information to be kept from any reader other than the authorised issuer.

The smart-home controller shall follow a configurable policy naming occupancy patterns and camera footage as sensitive data that cannot be exposed to third-party services without the owner's permission.
When the compiler detects that its telemetry feature is about to send source code fragments contrary to the configured disclosure rules, it shall drop all outbound telemetry messages.
If the web browser determines that a page script attempts to read data in breach of the configured privacy rules, the browser must block every pending network request from that page.

Should the online banking application detect that an outgoing message would expose account holder details contrary to its privacy rules, it shall suppress all messages in that exchange, including those to partner institutions.
The online banking application shall add a unique incrementing counter to each administrative command sent to the payment gateway so that a re-sent command can be told apart from a new one.
The electronic purse must include a time value or running sequence number in every top-up request it issues to the loading terminal so that stale copies of earlier requests are rejected.

The hospital patient-record system shall stamp every configuration update sent to a connected bedside device with the current time or a message counter, enabling the receiver to discard repeated updates.
